description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the ProtocolMessageExtractor class in the context of WebSocket protocol messages. It includes tests for extracting JWT tokens, start streaming commands with various parameters, and stop streaming commands. It also uses JUnit for testing and Mockito for mocking dependencies.
